title: How do I add products?
text: Use the product list to add an item and save it to your inventory.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Click Add Product.
Enter the product details and click Save.

title: How do I make a sale?
text: Open the register, add the items, and complete the payment to finish the sale.
steps: Open the register or Point of Sale.
Add the products to the sale.
Choose the payment method and finish the transaction.

title: How do I add stock?
text: Stock can be added through a purchase order, stock adjustment, or product quantity update.
steps: Open the inventory or product list.
Select the item and update the quantity.
Save the change to add the stock.

title: How do I make an end of day report?
text: Run an end-of-day reading from the cashier report to review sales, cash, and totals for the day.
steps: Open Cashier Report or End of Day.
Choose the reading you want to generate.
Review the totals and print or save the report.

title: How do I add a cashier?
text: Create a cashier profile and assign the user to the correct permissions and register.
steps: Open Users & Security.
Create or edit the user.
Assign cashier access and save the account.

title: How do I view reports?
text: Open the reporting section to view sales, inventory, and cash summaries by day or period.
steps: Click Sidebar > Reporting.
Choose the report you want to open.
Set the date range and review the results.

title: Sales today
text: This shows the sales recorded for the current day so you can check daily performance.
steps: Open the dashboard or reporting screen.
Choose today or the current date.
Review the sales total and trend.

title: Top selling products this month
text: See which items sold the most during the selected period.
steps: Open the dashboard or report page.
Choose the month you want to review.
Check the top selling products list.

title: Low stock products
text: Low stock items need attention because inventory is running below the set minimum.
steps: Open Inventory or Products.
Check the low stock list or inventory warning.
Restock the items that are running low.

title: Income statement this month
text: The income statement summarizes revenue, expenses, and profit for the selected period.
steps: Open Reporting.
Choose the income statement view.
Set the month and review the totals.
